title: Ethernaut Reentrance: external call before accounting
root_cause: External call sends value before sender balance is decremented
invariant: Withdrawal must not allow a sender to receive more value than its credited balance
detection: Analyze external value transfers preceding balance state updates; validate with isolated reentrant receiver and compare a patched variant
remediation: Apply checks-effects-interactions or a reentrancy guard and assert per-user balance conservation

title: Crytic historical reentrancy fixture
source_revision: master (unpinned; pin exact revision during collection)
root_cause: Untrusted callback can reenter before internal accounting completes
invariant: Withdrawals cannot drain deposits belonging to other accounts
detection: Use call-graph and state-update ordering analysis; validate against vulnerable and fixed functions
remediation: Update accounting before external calls and test adversarial receiver behavior
